item.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Platform/DevOps) @ Companies House [£41,509 - 58,044]
item.description:
Salary: £41,509 - 58,044 per year

Requirements:
  • Expert knowledge in Terraform
  • Expert knowledge in CI/CD tooling (e.g., Concourse)
  • Expert knowledge in Cloud Technology Principles (preferably AWS)
  • Strong practical experience in Containerisation (Docker)
  • Strong practical experience in Unix/Linux
  • Working knowledge of Ansible and Packer
  • Ability to lead on various streams of work
  • Ability to solve complex problems and provide technical support
  • Strong communication and influencing skills
  • Commitment to adherence to best practice guides
Responsibilities:
  • Deliver infrastructure and tooling to support continuous delivery
  • Focus on user and service needs, delivering value through improvements and automation
  • Build, administer, support, and maintain infrastructure solutions
  • Collaborate with development teams on infrastructure work
  • Ensure services are integrated and delivered as required
  • Work with technical architects to translate designs into operations
  • Design and develop infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines
  • Lead initiatives for non-functional requirements like availability and performance
  • Transform technical requirements into effective DevOps toolchain
Technologies:
  • AWS
  • Ansible
  • CI/CD
  • Cloud
  • DevOps
  • Docker
  • Support
  • Linux
  • Terraform
  • Unix
  • Git
  • Security

More:

At Companies House, we are offering an exciting opportunity to join our Digital, Data and Technology team as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer (DevOps/Platform). We prioritize a flexible and welcoming culture that promotes a healthy work-life balance. Our benefits include a comprehensive Civil Service Pension Scheme, flexible working hours, 30 days of annual leave plus bank holidays, and ongoing development opportunities. This role is based in our Cardiff office with hybrid working options available, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion, welcoming applications from all backgrounds.

item.title: Field IT Engineer @ Yellowcom Ltd [£28,000 - 40,000]
item.description:
Salary: £28,000 - 40,000 per year

Requirements:
  • Previous experience in IT support, field engineering, desktop support, or an MSP environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows PCs and laptops, including Windows 10 and Windows 11.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint Online.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, user accounts, MFA, and permissions.
  • Understanding of Microsoft Intune and device management.
  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPNs, routers, switches, and firewalls.
  • Ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity problems.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple support requests, and take ownership of issues through to resolution.
  • Comfortable travelling to customer sites and moving between different customer environments.
  • Full UK driving licence required.
  • Beneficial experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Defender, Kaseya Datto RMM, Datto AV and EDR, endpoint backup, Kaseya IT Glue, Autotask PSA, Spanning Backup, PowerShell, Microsoft 365 migrations, network installation and troubleshooting, Cyber Essentials, Cyber Essentials Plus, or Microsoft Azure.
  • Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or AZ-104 are beneficial but not essential.
  • Professional, approachable, technically curious, willing to learn, and organised.
Responsibilities:
  • Attend customer sites to diagnose and resolve IT issues.
  • Install and configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, and other IT equipment.
  • Set up new users, devices, and Microsoft 365 accounts.
  • Configure and manage Windows devices using Microsoft Intune and Autopilot.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, Wi-Fi, and connectivity issues.
  • Support Microsoft 365 migrations and customer onboarding projects.
  • Install and maintain endpoint security, monitoring, and backup solutions.
  • Monitor and manage customer devices using Kaseya Datto RMM.
  • Support Datto AV, Datto EDR, Microsoft Defender, and endpoint backup solutions.
  • Troubleshoot VPN and secure remote-access issues.
  • Assist with network equipment, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless access points.
  • Carry out PC replacements, upgrades, and user migrations.
  • Support printers, scanners, and other customer peripherals.
  • Escalate complex technical issues when required and work with senior engineers and third-party suppliers to resolve them.
  • Maintain accurate customer documentation, asset information, and technical records.
  • Provide clear updates to customers and internal teams throughout support cases and project work.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve or automate customer IT environments.
Technologies:
  • Azure
  • Cloud
  • Hardware
  • Support
  • Microsoft 365
  • Microsoft Intune
  • Network
  • PowerShell
  • Security
  • SharePoint
  • TCP/IP
  • VPN
  • Windows
  • Office 365
  • DevOps

More:

We are Yellowcom, and we are looking for a proactive, customer-focused Field IT Engineer to join our growing IT and Modern Workplace team. This hands-on role involves supporting customers across Northern Ireland and, where required, other locations across the UK and Ireland, with regular visits to customer sites. We offer a company car, ongoing technical training and professional development, support towards Microsoft and industry certifications, exposure to a wide range of Microsoft cloud, networking, cybersecurity, and managed IT technologies, and career progression within our team. Other benefits include a company pension, company events, a cycle to work scheme, employee discount, a health and wellbeing programme, on-site parking, and a referral programme. Pay is £28,000–£40,000 per year. The role is on the road.

item.title: AI Engineer Manager @ Kainos [£19,500 - 35,500]
item.description:
Salary: £19,500 - 35,500 per year

Requirements:
  • A minimum of a 2.1 degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Statistics or a similar quantitative field.
  • Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary teams to deliver AI/ML solutions to production.
  • Demonstrable technical leadership experience for AI delivery, including architecture, product design principles and engineering excellence.
  • Experience with modern AI engineering approaches such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, model evaluation and monitoring using metrics such as precision, recall, NDCG and drift detection.
  • Strong Python skills with a grounding in software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, testing and code reviews.
  • Experience developing solutions at scale on cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS, including containerisation and orchestration tools like Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Expertise in data engineering for AI, including handling large-scale, unstructured and multimodal data.
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles, model interpretability and ethical considerations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to lead client projects, manage C-level stakeholders and establish requirements and architecture concepts.
  • Experience managing, coaching and developing junior members of a team and wider community.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and with fine-tuning or distillation of LLMs such as GPT, Llama, Claude and Gemini.
  • Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn and XGBoost.
  • Experience with data storage for AI, vector databases, semantic search and knowledge graphs.
  • Active contribution to open-source AI projects, research publications and industry events or websites.
  • Familiarity with AI security, privacy and compliance standards such as ISO42001.
  • Experience shaping commercial AI offerings, winning AI work and providing wider pre-sales support.
Responsibilities:
  • Deliver advanced AI solutions leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI technologies.
  • Drive the adoption of modern AI frameworks, AIOps best practices and scalable cloud-native architectures.
  • Provide technical leadership and engage with senior stakeholders to agree architectural principles, strategic direction and system architecture.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning and engineering excellence.
  • Manage, coach and develop a team.
  • Develop standards and policies.
  • Build enduring customer relationships and embed commercial acumen.
  • Provide direction and leadership for the team as it solves challenging problems together.
Technologies:
  • Agentic AI
  • AI
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • CI/CD
  • Cloud
  • Docker
  • Fine-tuning
  • Support
  • Kubernetes
  • Machine Learning
  • PyTorch
  • Python
  • RAG
  • Security
  • TensorFlow

More:

We are Kainos, one of the UKs leading AI and data businesses, with a decade-long track record of delivering impactful, production-grade AI solutions for clients across government, healthcare, defence and commercial sectors. Our 150-strong AI and Data Practice brings together expertise in machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI and data, and we are trusted by Microsoft, AWS and others to deliver advanced AI and data solutions at citizen scale. We are pioneers in responsible AI and partner with leading organisations to ensure AI is deployed ethically, securely and with measurable business value. We offer a people-first culture where ideas are valued, growth is supported and contributions make a real difference. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion, and our friendly talent acquisition team supports candidates who need accommodations or adjustments during the recruitment process. This is a full-time role in our Data & Artificial Intelligence profession.

item.title: Principal Software Engineer / Principal AI Engineer - London @ Elsevier [£65,000 - 105,000]
item.description:
Salary: £65,000 - 105,000 per year

Requirements:
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on AI system design, development, or integration, and a record of taking AI prototypes into production in enterprise environments.
  • BS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Experience with LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, context-window management, production guardrails, MCP, tool-augmented agents, and enterprise-scale RAG.
  • Experience integrating AI into enterprise systems through APIs and data pipelines, with strong security, data governance, and data residency practices.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed AI/ML services.
  • Familiarity with Agile, CI/CD, modern SDLC, and TDD.
  • Data modeling experience across relational, columnar, and vector stores, grounded in sound architectural principles.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, define problems and specifications, and prioritize shipping validated outcomes and moving pilots into production.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, and relevant AI SDKs.
  • Ability to plan and sequence work, manage scope, dependencies, and priorities, remove blockers, and drive delivery.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, including presenting to senior management, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams and building support for technical decisions.
  • Commercial and budget awareness, including partnering with internal and external resources such as managed services and staff augmentation.
  • Ability to establish baselines and instrument solutions to track productivity, cost, and quality outcomes from pilot through scale.
Responsibilities:
  • Lead technical execution for an embedded Innovation Squad from discovery through production.
  • Build, assess, and harden AI prototypes and proofs of concept, and deliver new solutions.
  • Design and govern reusable agentic AI patterns for orchestration, tool use, memory, and retrieval.
  • Ensure delivery meets architecture, security, and data-governance standards; recommend infrastructure, hosting, and data residency approaches.
  • Turn validated solutions into reusable patterns, reference implementations, and starter kits for adoption and scaling across functions.
  • Provide design input, finalize requirements, and work directly with internal stakeholders and end users in the host function.
  • Write specifications, fix complex bugs, and design complex data models.
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for external resources and the squads coding and AI expert.
  • Establish baselines and report measurable outcomes for each initiative.
  • Track AI pilots within the function to prevent duplication and identify opportunities for reuse.
  • Maintain alignment with enterprise security, compliance, and central technology infrastructure standards.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and mentor and develop team members.
  • Take on related responsibilities as the squads needs evolve.
Technologies:
  • Agentic AI
  • AI
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • CI/CD
  • Embedded
  • GCP
  • Support
  • Java
  • JavaScript
  • LLM
  • MCP
  • Python
  • RAG
  • SQL
  • Security
  • TDD
  • TypeScript
  • Cloud

More:

We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer / Principal AI Engineer for our Embedded Innovation Teams, cross-functional squads embedded within our business segments. We work problem-first to turn internal AI experimentation into validated, reusable solutions, improve internal workflows, and help our people deliver better customer outcomes faster. The role is based in London Wall and is full time. We are a global leader in information and analytics, combining trusted information and extensive data with analytics to support science and research, health education, interactive learning, and healthcare. At Elsevier, our work contributes to major global challenges and a more sustainable future. We offer flexible working hours, wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, sabbaticals, a pension plan, generous vacation, family-care leave, a personal choice budget, employee communities and networks, discounts, an employee referral reward, and a global Employee Assistance Program. Benefits vary by country. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to a fair and accessible hiring process.
